prompt: Run /builder:lint on the project at /home/user/Card-Framework. Use the --all flag (default). Report what findings you get and show the full output.

assertions.text: Report contains a findings-by-rule table referencing all 7 rules (A1, A2, A3a, A3b, A4, S1, S2)
